summary: Iteration 3 testing complete. 23/23 backend pytest passing (14 regression from iter2 + 9 new for probability/confluence/take). 9 new tests verify: /api/signal/active and /api/recommendation include probability {label,percent,take,reason} and confluence {timeframes,aligned_count,total_count,direction,avg_strength,details}; recommendation includes take(bool), take_label(str), take_reason(str), probability(str); STRICT FILTER works (signal=null when prob BAJA/MEDIA or confluence dir mismatches; recommendation says NO TOMAR with reason); probability rating thresholds (ULTRA aligned>=3 + pct>=80; ALTA aligned>=2 + pct>=65; MEDIA pct>=50; else BAJA); confluence.details has {tf,dir,score} per TF. Frontend Playwright validated against live preview URL: RecommendationBanner shows rec-probability badge 'Prob. BAJA' + take-recommendation strip with take-label 'NO TOMAR' and take-reason populated. BullsBearsGauge SVG semicircle renders with 5 curved labels (Venta Fuerte, Venta, Neutral, Compra, Compra Fuerte), needle, histogram (36 bars), and RSI/CCI/Trends 3-col grid + bb-label 'Venta (5m)' matching score sector. ConfluencePanel shows 3 TFs (5m↓ 15m↓ 1h—) with 'Veredicto: VENTA' and confluence count 2/3. Live market currently at probability=BAJA / confluence aligned=2/3 / direction=SELL while analysis=NEUTRAL → strict filter correctly suppresses signal and shows ESPERAR + NO TOMAR.
critical_code_review_comments: compute_probability gives session_bonus=5 only when session_label contains 'LONDRES' or 'NUEVA YORK'; correct given /api/sessions returns 'LONDRES/NY' for overlap.

_make_signal returns None unless probability ALTA/ULTRA AND confluence.direction==analysis.direction — strict filter validated. Note: aligned_count uses max(buy,sell), so on a 3-TF set with 2 BUY + 1 SELL aligned_count=2 with confluence.direction=BUY which then must match analysis direction; OK.
BullsBearsGauge bars are pseudo-derived from score sign (not from real history). Acceptable cosmetic; consider feeding from STATE['ticks'] for real micro-trend visualization.

RecommendationBanner overrides take_label fallback as 'RECOMENDABLE'/'NO RECOMENDABLE' which mismatches backend strings 'NO TOMAR' / 'CERRAR AHORA' / 'TOMAR PARCIAL'. In practice backend always supplies take_label, so the fallback never shows — UI verified to render the backend value verbatim.

Frontend gauge sectors use thresholds ±20/±50 while backend score uses ±25 to flip BUY/SELL/NEUTRAL — small inconsistency: bb-label can show 'Neutral' when analysis direction is BUY/SELL with score in 20..25. Cosmetic only.
compute_confluence returns aligned_count=max(buy,sell) but if buy==sell==1 with one neutral, aligned_count=1 and direction=NEUTRAL (correct). All edge cases tested live.
